notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Stormfront Riders from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Stormfront Riders enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, returning it and any other creature you control except Thermopod from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {R}.
Repeat.
